title: Lotus Heart

outfit_card.silhouette: Asymmetric layered robe silhouette with a short front hem and cascading back panels, paired with a high-waisted inner skirt and sheer wing-like sleeves, creating a voluminous, ethereal couture line.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Intricate silver lotus-and-butterfly hairpins with dangling pearl tassels, paired with a delicate forehead chain and small gemstone accents.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Deep-plunge cross-collar bodice with intricate silver filigree embroidery and beaded chains; wide sheer organza sleeves with gradient ink-wash patterns, layered over a structured inner blouse, finished with pearl-and-tassel trims.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Layered silk skirt with a short, scalloped front hem featuring silver wave embroidery, over a long sheer petticoat; paired with dark, embroidered lace-up ankle boots with a subtle heel.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Translucent butterfly wings with iridescent accents, floating lotus motifs, and a small companion creature in a dark hooded cape.
